subject.title: fix(scripts): bound dependency pin git lookups

question: Should the dependency-pin guard expose `OPENCLAW_DEPENDENCY_PINS_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS` as a supported operator override, or keep the one-minute timeout fixed and use an internal-only test mechanism?
rationale: This is a new environment configuration surface for a dependency-safety guard, so code review cannot determine the intended operational and compatibility contract without maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep the timeout fixed
options.body: Retain the one-minute production bound and replace the public environment override with a test-only mechanism that does not create an operator-facing contract.

options.title: Approve the override contract
options.body: Keep the capped environment override, but explicitly document its supported use and validate the default and overridden behavior as intentional.

recommendation.title: Keep the timeout fixed
recommendation.body: Retain the one-minute production bound and replace the public environment override with a test-only mechanism that does not create an operator-facing contract.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable current-main ownership trail was available in the supplied review context.
